name: Hamilton County, TN
findings: Hamilton County has 1,324 nonprofit organizations. 521 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 381 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Hamilton County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 114 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 114 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few housing organizations list membership
observations.text: 1 housing organization here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 5 would.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through housing groups? Where else does that happen?
